name: Navbar
summary: Top app bar — the single highest-level navigation chrome. Hosts brand mark, primary destinations (or a 'More' overflow), global search trigger, NotificationCenter trigger, account menu. Three variants: marketing (translucent + scroll-aware reveal), operator (compact 48 px chrome), mobile (40 px + hamburger drawer). Always one Navbar per page.

brand.description: Lumen mark, logotype, or wordmark slot. Pair with a link to /.

destinations.description: Sequence of NavItems. Operator: shows up to 5 inline, overflow to 'More' DropdownMenu. Marketing: shows all inline, optional MegaMenu reveal. Mobile: collapses behind a hamburger Drawer.

trailing.description: Right-side slot — search trigger, NotificationCenter trigger, account avatar, theme toggle.

sticky.description: When true, position:sticky top:0. Marketing variant additionally applies scroll-translucent backdrop.

container.description: full: edge-to-edge (operator). page: max-width container matching the body grid (marketing).

elevation.description: border: hairline bottom (operator default). shadow: drop shadow (marketing scroll-state). none: floats free.

keyboard: Tab - move focus across destinations and trailing actions
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight - move within destinations (when grouped via role='menubar')
Escape - close any open dropdown / mobile drawer
rules: Root is <nav aria-label='Primary'> or aria-label='Marketing primary'.
Include a skip link inside the Navbar that jumps to <main id='main-content'>.
Each NavItem with a submenu uses aria-haspopup='menu' + aria-expanded.
Mobile hamburger has aria-label='Open menu' and toggles aria-expanded.

do: One Navbar per page. Don't stack two.
Marketing variant: translucent glass on scroll past the hero — backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%).
Operator variant: 48 px chrome, hairline border, inline destinations, ⌘K command palette trigger.
Always include a skip link as the first focusable inside.
dont: Don't put a destructive action in the Navbar. The Navbar is for navigation.
Don't paint the active item in solid lime — use action.selected.bg + text.accent.
Don't auto-hide the Navbar on scroll-down without an obvious return affordance.
Don't render two CTAs in the trailing slot. The trailing is for utility (notifications, account) not promo.

changelog.note: Initial Navbar contract. Marketing / operator / mobile variants. Skip-link contract.
